description: Channel governance hash-chain (SPEC §8.3.1). A descriptor change (here: add an admin) is a NEW kind-30110 version with supersedes -> the prior descriptor_id, signed by the founder OR a prior-epoch admin. Since 0.3.0 each version has its own d-tag ('oc-lock-chat-ch:' || descriptor_id) and both carry t = channel_id, so a relay keeps both and a reader fetches them by #t; v2 also carries s = its supersedes, so a reader can walk forward from v1 by #s. Proves the new descriptor is a distinct content-addressed artifact (different descriptor_id), so governance is tamper-evident + offline-verifiable. A replacement not signed by a prior-epoch admin/founder is E_CH_UNAUTHORIZED.
notes: v2 adds an admin + sets supersedes=v1 descriptor_id. descriptor_v2_id = hex(sha256(canonical(v2)+'\n')). Each has its own d-tag, 'oc-lock-chat-ch:' || its descriptor_id, and both carry t = channel_id, so v2 does not replace v1 at any relay; the ids differ. v2's s tag is v1's descriptor_id. A conforming client accepts v2 only if signed by the founder or an admin present in v1's admins set.
